context: Request: the firm's M&A deals that never reached closing, including mergers that could not be cleared (lessons-learned review). Rubric: eight qualifying matters (1001-00005, 1002-00004, 1003-00001, 1011-00005, 1017-00007, 1018-00008, 1020-00006, 1032-00005) plus precision; 1023-00001, 1038-00001 and 1022-00002/1022-00006 are outside the set.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob in parallel with directory and file counts and a two-level folder listing capped at 40 lines.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: Lists and saves all 266 matter folder names.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction scan with broad termination and regulatory words; the full run times out, a four-shard rerun gives hits in every matter. The review flags that the terms do not discriminate.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Attempt 2: rescan with a narrower failed-close phrase list; several syntax fixes and timeouts, then four shards give 125 matters. The review flags loose phrases.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Path regex for termination, withdrawal and regulatory words (807 paths, 127 matters), then filtered to scan-hit matters with decisive file names (98 lines). The review flags the narrowing; its label note says scan work, with no later work of that kind.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists all files of twelve hand-picked candidates; the review and harness list name surfaced matters left unlisted.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Attempt 2: writes file inventories of all 125 scan-hit matters to a file; only a summary is shown.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: A reconciliation script refused because no stage was open, then reads of status, termination and withdrawal papers of about ten candidates, a deal-file script over the 125 matters, and listings of two more.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Attempt 2: filtered listings and status-memo reads of four more candidates.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes five non-closing deals with reasons and documents, including a dormant energy deal, plus exclusions.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Checks cited paths and adds a note on a matter-number mismatch.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Attempt 2: re-reads the response and two sources of the mismatched matter.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → List matter folders → Scan document text with an extraction script → Search file names for request keywords → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: A narrower phrase rescan never reached four needed matters, a file-name filter then dropped two more that the scan had found, and a dormant deal was added.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.critic_note: The review at [40] flagged the phrase list as too loose, not as missing matters; no review named the four matters.
first_error.why: Its narrower failed-close phrase rescan returned 125 matters but none of four needed matters, whose only earlier appearance was a scan where every matter hit, and it ran no other content search for them.

other_errors.stage: Search file names for request keywords
other_errors.critic_note: (specific flag) The review at [52] named the narrowing to decisive file names, and the harness unopened-matter lists from [24] named one of the two matters; the agent inventoried all 125 scan matters but still read a hand-picked set.
other_errors.why: Two needed matters were in its 125-matter phrase scan ([38]), but its decisive-file-name filter dropped them and it never opened them.

other_errors.critic_note: No review questioned the dormant energy deal.
other_errors.why: A dormant deal outside the set is written as a non-closing M&A transaction (evidence seen at [84]-[88]).

runs.failure_point: Read a hand-picked set of candidates and never opened three needed matters its own path search and no-closing regex showed, and added a merger still in litigation.

first_error.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) The harness unopened-matter lists from [19] named one of the three matters, and the reviews at [39] and [75] flagged the hand-picked candidates; the agent never opened them.
first_error.why: Three needed matters were in its path search ([17]) and in its own no-closing regex over the scan ([68]), but it read other candidates and comparators and never opened them; a fourth never appeared in a discriminating result.

other_errors.critic_note: (specific flag) The write review at [92] named the sixth, still-pending matter; the agent kept it.
other_errors.why: A merger still in regulatory litigation is included as an additional non-closing transaction (evidence seen at [49]-[55]).

divergence: All fail; the runs found the same core matters (the outside-date lapse, the regulatory-filing withdrawal and, in T1 and T2, the terminated deal and a merger ended on regulatory grounds) and missed the same group of four. They failed at different stages. T0's first error is its narrower phrase rescan, which never returned four needed matters (no review named them), after which a decisive-file-name filter dropped two more (reviewed and partly acted on). T1 abandoned its only content scan with five of six ranges unfinished despite a specific review flag. T2 completed its scan, but chose a hand-picked set to read and never opened three matters its own path search and no-closing regex showed; harness unopened-matter lists named one of them from early on. T0 and T2 each added a matter outside the set (a dormant deal; a merger still in litigation, flagged by T2's write review). Label notes were followed once (T2 declared a scan after a path search) and otherwise had no effect.
